title: Notes Java Introduction To Looping Control Constructs 1

runs.text: Code redundancy means writing the same code repeatedly to perform the same task.
statement five times to print the same text five times is redundant code.
Looping control constructs are used when a statement or a set of statements has to be executed repeatedly.
They help avoid writing the same code again and again, thereby reducing code redundancy.
3. What are the three standard looping control constructs in Java?
The three standard looping control constructs are:

blocks.text:
for 
while 
do-while

Performing the same operation for a sequence of values.

— whether the controlling value should move forward or backward.
6. What is initialization in a loop?
Initialization specifies the starting value of the loop-control variable.
